rationale: Empty custom timesteps skip the descending-order loop and then raise IndexError on timesteps[0] in DDPMScheduler.set_timesteps. Code style and philosophy ask for a concise error instead of substituting a default timestep. The check belongs in that method, after the existing mutual-exclusion ValueError, so valid schedules and the current argument contract stay the same. DDPMParallelScheduler.set_timesteps is marked Copied from the DDPM method, so the copy tool propagates the check. The philosophy page still names set_num_inference_steps; the method that exists is set_timesteps.
